Our integrated Holiday Clubs allow SEND & non-SEND children to connect and grow together.

1st SEND Club

Learning Made Fun and Easy.

Holiday Club is the perfect place for kids to have fun and learn during their school break. Our program includes a variety of activities such as arts crafts, science experiments, games, and more. ​ The club is available at a minimal cost, FSM students are free.
